entries.principle: Human rights and democratic values, including fairness and privacy

entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V of 21 May 2013, On Personal Data and their Protection
entries.why_here: Name language caused 2 flips, gender-coded names 4, and university 1 out of 40 pairs; none clearly exceeded its floor, but hiding names and universities limits unnecessary model exposure.
